assertions: The canonical accepted submission was completed by a fenced durable attempt and linked to a Prefect flow-run ID.

A controlled Prefect client returned a Failed state while ETLantic reported completed; the status projection reported reconciliation status conflict and kept both remote observation and observation time separate.
Reading managed status did not change the completed canonical submission or its completed attempt.
limitations: This proves bounded status projection and non-mutation with a controlled client; it does not exercise a live Prefect/PostgreSQL terminal disagreement or the required cancellation staging/publication boundaries.
